summary: ADAM conversational workspace (iteration 4) — full backend + end-to-end frontend verified. Backend pytest 12/12 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_adam_leads.py covering: /api/adam/discover (schema + LLM JSON extraction + two-turn extraction of industry/business_type/location + auto-upsert into adam_leads with DRAFT status, lead_score>0, transcript merged), /api/adam/lead/upsert (partial merges never wipe + auto-promotion to QUALIFIED once (email or phone) AND (name or company) AND (goal or industry) all present), /api/adam/lead/{sid} (200 + 404), /api/adam/summary (business-only when site_context null; adds website block when site_context provided; DB doc updated to ANALYSIS_COMPLETED with business_summary and website_summary), /api/adam/handover (adam_leads → CONTACT_REQUESTED, new row in contacts with source='adam-workspace' matching profile, returns lead_id/status/score, Resend fire-and-forget non-blocking), regressions /api/adam/roadmap (contains 'Days 1-30' content), /api/adam/status, /api/adam/scrape, /api/blogs, /api/contact. Frontend Playwright end-to-end: adam:open → 16 narrative continues → adam-explore-btn → adam-workspace → opening line 'Let's start simple. What are you trying to achieve right now?' + exactly 8 opening chips matching spec. 'More Leads' chip click → user bubble → typing indicator visible → new assistant bubble ('Got it—more qualified leads. What industry are you in?') → new contextual chips (Home services, Healthcare, Professional services, E-commerce — NOT the original 8). Two substantive replies (furniture showroom + audience) triggered adam-offer-website with url-input + scan-btn + skip-website. Clicked skip-website → summary-loading → adam-summary rendered with 4 rows (business snapshot); NO website card (as expected). adam-deep-menu with all 5 buttons present. Clicked adam-deep-roadmap → adam-roadmap with 5018 chars of markdown ('YOUR 90-DAY ROADMAP · Diagnosis · Metrics · The one lever ...'). Clicked adam-open-handover → adam-handover-modal → filled name+email → adam-handover-submit → adam-handover-success 'Brief sent to the studio.' Mongo verified post-run: adam_leads doc status='CONTACT_REQUESTED', score=62, merged profile has {goal:'More leads', industry:'Handmade wood furniture', business_type:'Furniture showroom', location:'Pune', audience:'...', name:'TEST_HandoverUI', email:'test_ui_handover@example.com'}. contacts row {source:'adam-workspace', name:'TEST_HandoverUI', email:'test_ui_handover@example.com'} present. All test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: adam_leads.py:281 suggestions capped at 5 (spec says up to 4 chips — LLM output already limited via prompt). Harmless.
adam_leads.py:213 auto-promote logic is correct: requires (email OR phone) AND (name OR company) AND (goal OR industry). Verified.
adam_leads.py:519 asyncio.create_task(_send()) is fire-and-forget — endpoint returns 200 even if Resend fails. Correct.

AdamWorkspace.jsx:243 phase-transition heuristic 'substantiveFields >= 5' can trip before 4 explicit turns because LLM sometimes extracts multiple fields per turn (e.g. industry+business_type+location from one message). Not a bug — spec says 4-5 substantive turns, and in practice we saw offer_website after 3 turns because LLM captured 5 fields cumulatively. Acceptable UX.
AdamWorkspace.jsx:281 runScan closure uses stale scan reference for siteContextSummary — but generateSummary is called with fresh siteScanArg so ok.

AdamWorkspace.jsx line 62 useTypewriter renders assistant text char-by-char client side; when isLatest=false the passed speedMs=0 still triggers setInterval with 0ms — harmless (finishes in single tick) but wastes a state update. Consider skipping the effect when isLatest=false.

Console showed several 502 responses during initial narrative — these are the optional /api/adam/voice endpoint when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not configured; endpoint returns 503 which the frontend gracefully ignores. Not a defect.

No admin regression tested this iteration — assumed unchanged (iteration 3 already fully validated /adcom-admin cookie flow and blog CRUD). Recommend main agent trust prior report unless code changed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (full end-to-end conversational flow with DB verification)

test_credentials: No auth needed for ADAM workspace (public). Admin session pattern documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md unchanged.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_ prefixed data (adam_leads with session_id ^adam_ prefix, contacts with source='adam-workspace') cleaned via mongosh at end of tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_adam_leads.py — run via `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest backend/tests/test_adam_leads.py -v`. Full narrative walk to workspace takes 16-20 continue-clicks (~35-45s) — be patient with adam-continue loop (30+ iterations, 3s each). After 'More Leads' chip, LLM often extracts multiple profile fields per user reply so offer_website appears after only 2-3 substantive turns instead of the spec-target 4-5 (this is desirable behavior — trust the substantiveFields>=5 heuristic in AdamWorkspace.jsx:243). LLM timings: /discover ~2-4s, /summary ~4-8s, /roadmap ~15-30s. Session_id can be captured via page.on('request') listening for POST /api/adam/discover.
